name: dsh-apiproxy-shim
description: Compatibility shim: re-provides the rc.7 `apiProxy` service on harness 0.1.5+ by bridging apiProxy.sessions.prompt({rpcId,payload}) onto the new host service sessionController.prompt({requestId,sessionId,mode,content}). v0.2.0 appends the trailing AbortSignal that the typert gateway would normally inject (descriptor.cancellation), fixing "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'throwIfAborted')"; failures now carry prompt.length + stack diagnostics.
